# SartorialAI

> SartorialAI is an AI front desk and revenue system for small and mid-size businesses. A team of named AI agents answers every call, text and chat, books appointments, qualifies and follows up on leads, publishes content and monitors AI search visibility, 24/7. Free plan available, paid plans from $497/month, live within 48 hours, no setup fees. SartorialAI is a trademark of Sartorial Digital, LLC.

## AI team
- Front Desk: Aria (inbound calls), Max (booking and scheduling), Nova (customer support)
- Growth: Zane (lead qualification), Savannah (nurture and follow-up), Dax (outbound sales)
- Brand: Reese (content and marketing)
- Operations: Kai (executive operations)
- AI Co-Founder: a daily approve-or-skip queue of content, outreach, follow-ups and reply drafts

## Pricing
- Free: ideal customer profile, starter leads, 5-email sequence, content plan, website chat agent
- Solo Operator, $497/month: 24/7 AI call answering, booking, lead capture, SMS and web chat, CRM sync
- Scaling Fast, $997/month: adds outbound calling, lead scoring, advanced follow-up, up to 3 locations
- Full Automation, from $1,797/month: unlimited conversations, custom workflows and integrations, dedicated account manager
